violation_type.title: Electronic CO Detection Sys Connected to Alarm/Smoke Detection Sys-Tested Annually by Company or State or Local Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5537(b)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Electronic CO Detection Sys Connected to Alarm/Smoke Detection Sys-Tested Annually by Company or State or Local Fire Marshal
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation has the smoke detector/Carbon monoxide detector connected to an alarm system. The alarm panel system has not been inspected by a system monitoring company since 10/4/22.

finding_variants.text: The operation has the smoke detector/Carbon monoxide detector connected to an alarm system. The alarm panel system has not been inspected by a system monitoring company since 10/4/22.

The operation uses an electronic carbon monoxide/smoke detection system connected to an alarm. The system has not been currently inspected by the system monitoring company or the fire marshal. The last inspection was conducted on 1/20/21. Photo of last inspection record was taken.
The operation's carbon monoxide/smoke detector system is connected to an alarm panel. The alarm panel has not currently been serviced. The last time it was serviced was on 10/18/22.
The operation did not have the up-to-date annual carbon monoxide detector inspection documentation available.
The carbon monoxide detection system is connected to the alarm/smoke detection system. The alarm system has not been tested within the past year by the local alarm company.
The daycare's carbon monoxide detector system is wired into the fire panel system. The system's last inspection was conducted on 11/11/2020.
